# Technical Protection Systems

> Technical Protection Systems specializes in fire-resistant glazing, bullet-resistant doors and windows, and energy-efficient architectural protection solutions for Australian and international markets.

Technical Protection Systems (TPS) is an Australian-based provider of specialized protection systems including fire-resistant glazing, bullet-resistant doors and windows, smoke-resistant systems, and energy-efficient framing solutions. The company partners with leading manufacturers like Pilkington, Forster Profile Systems, and Micomdoor to deliver comprehensive protection across residential, commercial, and medical applications.

## Key Topics

- Fire-resistant glazing
- Bullet-resistant doors and windows
- Smoke-resistant systems
- Energy-efficient framing
- Architectural steel framing
- Intruder-resistant windows
- Cyclone-resistant windows
- Medical hermetic doors
- Stainless steel doors
- Presto XS
- Fuego Light
- Thermfix Vario
- AS1530.4 compliance
- Australia and New Zealand markets
- Product launches and awards
